published_ranges._enclosure: Creality: for fully enclosed printers, otherwise an enclosure is needed.
published_ranges._notes: Creality filament parameter reference table (2024-12-23): recommended 250C nozzle, 80C bed, 50 mm/s. K2 Plus table: 260C/90C, 50C chamber, 14 mm3/s (printer profile values). Store name 'Creality HP ASA'.

conflicts: Print speed: EU store product page (https://store.creality.com/eu/products/creality-hp-asa) says 'Print Speed Up to 200mm/s' vs 30-60 mm/s in the parameter table.
